# Red Alert Remastered Modding Field Manual

> Techniques and facts about modding the Command & Conquer Remastered Collection (Steam app 1213210), verified in
> Tiberian Factions. Each page is self-contained and laid out the same way: when you need it, the fact or method, how it
> was verified, the game build it holds for, and what is still unproven. Licensed CC BY 4.0. EA has not endorsed and
> does not support this product.

Every page's frontmatter carries `holds_for` (the Steam build it was verified on), `status`, and `unproven` (the
claims not yet tested). Pages that patch the launcher's memory also carry `clientg_sha256`. Before applying any
offset from such a page, check the SHA-256 of the user's `ClientG.exe` against it, and stop if they differ.

## Getting started

- [The mod folder and ccmod.json](getting-started/the-mod-folder-and-ccmod-json.md): a mod is ccmod.json plus a
  Data/ tree; local mods in Documents\CnCRemastered\Mods\Red_Alert (or Tiberian_Dawn); Workshop items need a named
  subfolder; the version is two integers shown as high.low.
- [Building the DLL on Linux](getting-started/building-the-dll-on-linux.md): cross-compile the game DLL with 32-bit
  mingw (i686 toolchain, Vanilla Conquer's remaster preset, VC_CXX_FLAGS="-w;-fpermissive"); strip it before
  shipping; the build's mod folder is copied only on relink and never loses files, so restage it.
- [Testing under Proton and on the Steam Deck](getting-started/testing-under-proton.md): copy the mod into the game's
  Proton prefix (compatdata/1213210) with rsync -ac --delete, with the game closed; crashes are logged in
  log/CrashLog.txt; build DLL log paths from USERPROFILE; headless, the placement grid follows only relative pointer
  motion (one run).
- [Publishing to the Workshop from Linux](getting-started/publishing-to-the-workshop-from-linux.md): a SteamUGC
  uploader using EA's .workshop.json fields; restart Steam first, description at most 8000 characters, upload real
  folders in a named subfolder; EA's Uploader.exe hangs the same way; the launcher's mod tags and the map tags.

- [HD-only mods](getting-started/hd-only-mods.md): the manual assumes HD graphics mode; switch off the classic option
  with CNCDisableLegacyGraphicsOption in GameConstants_Mod.xml when new art exists only in HD; TD's classic art: the
  palette remap rule and the Obelisk beam's RA indices.

## File formats

- [MEG and MIX archives](formats/meg-and-mix-archives.md): MEG = upper-case paths, 20-byte entries sorted by CRC,
  no checksum (EA's Megafile.cs); classic MIX = name-hash index sorted by signed CRC; RA's outer MIX = flags header
  (0x2 encrypted, 0x1 SHA-1 trailer; RA ships 0x0, 0x2 and 0x3), RSA-wrapped Blowfish key, encrypted index.
- [Save files (.sav)](formats/save-files.md): a CH ChunkFile: zlib stream (size at 0x10) ending in a sync flush,
  a zlib chunk index, then a 20-byte instance header (size at +8) and raw deflate holding the DLL's save data.

## Launcher data

- [Overriding the launcher's data](launcher-data/overriding-launcher-data.md): a loose file under Data/ replaces
  its CONFIG.MEG member whole; a replacement CONFIG.MEG must keep every member's exact size; GameConstants_Mod.xml
  merges over GameConstants.xml (overwrite="true" replaces a list). The instance server reads none of them. Team
  colours are an example: loose CNCRATEAMCOLORS.XML or CNCTDTEAMCOLORS.XML, one HSV-shift entry per house. Other
  archives' members load loose too: a Bink Data/ART/MOVIES/RA/REDINTRO.BK2 replaces the startup intro.
- [New text strings](launcher-data/new-text-strings.md): add strings with a loose Data/ModText.csv (UTF-16 LE with
  a BOM; TEXT ID, AUDIO TAG, CHARACTER, then a column per language), merged at load; the MASTERTEXTFILE .LOC table
  can only be relabelled at its exact size.
- [Mod hotkey commands](launcher-data/mod-hotkey-commands.md): CNCEnableModHotKeyGameCommands turns on
  GAME_COMMAND_CNC_MOD_COMMAND_1-4; the DLL gets INPUT_REQUEST_MOD_GAME_COMMAND_n_AT_POSITION with the cell under the
  mouse; players bind the keys, a mod can't ship bindings; EA's 2020 comment on the constant; keys written as
  <Key>VIRTUAL_KEY_F3</Key>.

## Front end

- [The UI atlas](front-end/the-ui-atlas.md): launcher 2D UI is regions of MT_COMMANDBAR_COMMON (6871x6716) with an
  .MTD region table; ship a full repainted copy loose, as TGA or DXT5 DDS with mips (padded to 6872 wide); region
  boxes are fixed; per side vs per country; .MTD is a count then length-prefixed name and x,y,w,h records; the big
  lobby logo sizes; the title logo is UI_RA_MAINLOGO.DDS on the main menu and an atlas region on campaign select.
- [BUI screens](front-end/bui-screens.md): .BUI ChunkFiles ('CH', v2.1, zlib at 0x24, hash unchecked); reshape,
  hide, retint, retexture, clone widgets; FACTIONS.XML GUIFileNames picks the screen. Loose any size. Names are
  length-prefixed leaves and micro-chunks; the nine stock effects in GUIEFFECTS.CFX; the spinner is a 4x4 sheet.
- [New screens and buttons](front-end/new-screens-and-buttons.md): clone a stock button in a loose RA_MAIN_MENU.BUI
  and bind its click from a hook; a new screen is a loose .BUI on ClientG's unused SplashScreen class, opened with
  GUIManager/Create_Scene_Instance. Fragile: one ClientG build; handlers are member calls (object in ecx, data on the
  stack); leave the skirmish lobby through its Back handler; the launcher's own message box.
- [A faction encyclopedia screen](front-end/faction-encyclopedia.md): a new SplashScreen-class screen listing each
  faction's units with picture, description and live stats; the DLL processes the mod's rules inside ClientG, draws
  pictures into a canvas texture shipped at start-up, and fills a stock list box. Fragile: one ClientG build; rows
  filled as the stock Mission Select list does (MissionColumn, event 4); mplayer.ini's nine rule readers; a generic
  column name gives no layout; finding a row's widgets.

## Using what the player already owns

- [TD art from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-art-from-the-base-game.md): draw Tiberian Dawn's HD
  art in a Red Alert mod from the base game's TEXTURES_TD_SRGB.MEG, using opener tiles, instead of shipping copies.
- [TD theatres in Red Alert](using-what-the-player-owns/td-theatres-in-red-alert.md): add TD's desert, temperate and
  winter as Red Alert theatres: launcher slots in GameConstants_Mod.xml, a matching TheaterType and templates in the
  DLL; TD's desert trees and rocks need new terrain types; TD .BIN maps are 64x64 (template, icon) bytes.
- [TD sounds from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-sounds-from-the-base-game.md): play Tiberian Dawn's
  sound effects and EVA lines in a Red Alert mod from the base game's sound MEGs, by naming each sound in the DLL and
  adding RAC_/RAR_ alias events; your own samples must be MS-ADPCM; IN_VAR responses get a .V00-.R03 suffix; DLL-sent
  lines take ffmpeg's default block; infantry get .V01/.V03, vehicles .V00/.V02; the event's priority and context come
  from the table's Priority and Where.

## Maps and the lobby

- [New maps in the skirmish Official list](maps-and-lobby/new-maps-in-the-skirmish-list.md): list maps with
  INSTANCES.XML and CNCMAPPREVIEWDATA.XML (RA's 128-wide grid); start them under Hastings' D6 entry, whose
  OverrideMapName the DLL honours, by hooking ClientG's launch sends and key lookup. Fragile: one ClientG build; or
  ship a player custom map (.mpr/.tga/.json, CNC_Start_Custom_Instance); a map ships in the mod's root CCDATA/; a
  mod's Data/CNCDATA/ is never searched; Workshop maps named UGC_<steamid>_<item>_MAPDATA.MPR with previews apart.
- [Bigger maps](maps-and-lobby/bigger-maps.md): maps up to 255 cells a side (253x253 playable): widen CELL to 32 bits
  with 8-bit X/Y, patch InstanceServerG's two export copies (0x59235A, 0x5982A4) to read bigger arrays, re-encode
  offsets on the launcher's 128-wide grid, skip the legacy render. Byte cell fields cap it at 255; the engine survey:
  negative cell IDs, zone wrap, HIGH_COORD_MASK, the MapPack layout; MapPack framing: 0xFFFF clear, 8 KB LCW blocks
  behind two u16 counts, 70-character numbered CRLF lines, signed overlay bytes.
- [A map editor for Linux and mods](maps-and-lobby/a-map-editor-for-linux-and-mods.md): cnc-map-editor, Mobius's
  core on .NET 8 with an Avalonia window, for RA and TD on Linux and the Steam Deck; saves byte-identical to Mobius's
  on all 230 official RA maps, render within 5 of Mobius's under partial-alpha sprites; mapeditor.json beside
  ccmod.json (format 1: buildings, units, infantry, templates, resources; bad entries skipped with warnings; stock
  then earlier mod wins); the cncmap CLI (info, validate, render, save, edit, new, generate, expand-mission, mods);
  caps 128x128 RA, 64x64 TD.

- [Adding a theatre of your own](maps-and-lobby/custom-theatres.md): slot and DLL steps are proven by TD's theatres,
  but a new terrain template name with loose art crashes the launcher; custom terrain reskins existing template names
  (loose DDS at the stock path); new templates go at 401 and up, after HILL01; a missing classic iconset makes a 0x0
  template, a malformed one divides by zero.
- [Custom campaigns: replacing the official ones](maps-and-lobby/custom-campaigns.md): INSTANCES.XML decides what
  Mission Select shows (ShowOnMissionSelect, IsUnlockedAtStart, ExternalGameID), the campaign files what launches;
  replace a stock mission by shipping its scenario (SC<house><nn><dir><var>.INI) in CCDATA/ without [Digest]; the
  digest abort exists because RELEASE_VERSION is defined; instance movie fields; expansion missions unlocked at start,
  what a Variant base carries, where the stock scenarios sit; TD's *_MISSIONS.XML files and the Mission Select
  .BUI screens of both games.
- [Per-AI lobby difficulty](maps-and-lobby/per-ai-lobby-difficulty.md): the launcher never sends per-AI skirmish
  difficulty to the DLL; read ClientG's AIPLAYERn records (stride 0xA8: team +0x50, ActLike +0x54, difficulty +0x64,
  colour +0x68) and pick the live copy. Read-only. Fragile: one ClientG build; AI houses' IniName becomes 'Computer'
  before CNC_Set_Difficulty (1 in skirmish, -1 in LAN); what the settings file holds (tagged records, CASUAL label,
  match-start counter).
- [A new resource on the official skirmish maps](maps-and-lobby/official-maps-with-tiberium.md): rewrite the 230
  stock SCM<n>EA.INI maps from MAIN.MIX (OverlayPack, MINE lines, [STRUCTURES]), shadow them from CCDATA, repaint
  the MOBIUS_RED_ALERT_MULTIPLAYER_<N>_MAP.DDS thumbnails, add the overlay's tiles to every theatre.

## Sound and music

- [EVA voice lines the launcher plays](sound-and-music/launcher-eva-lines-by-faction.md): nine EVA voice lines are
  played by ClientG itself; write each faction's recording over the launcher's sample names at match start, and over
  ClientG's cached copy (same-length payloads, whole-file compare before writing). Fragile: one ClientG build; Wine's
  CopyFile leaves partial copies in freed heap.
- [Credit tick and radar sounds by faction](sound-and-music/credit-tick-and-radar-by-faction.md): the launcher
  plays both itself; silence its copy and fire the faction's sound from the DLL under new event names, per house.
- [Music by faction, and the jukebox](sound-and-music/music-by-faction-and-the-jukebox.md): AUDIO_FACTIONS
  MusicMap is unused and the DLL can't play music, so redirect ClientG's skirmish music lookup to a per-faction
  event; jukebox entries are removed only before the jukebox manager's setup. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Engine

- [What the launcher owns: the modding walls](engine/what-the-launcher-owns.md): each behaviour ClientG owns, with
  its route (data, cached-record RAM, launcher code patch) or the evidence it's a real wall. Search data first, then
  the DLL interface, then ClientG memory, then code; the cut co-op campaign mode.
- [Adding a faction](engine/adding-a-faction.md): houses are a fixed enum, so a new side rides one of the lobby's
  eight country rows, either remapped to HOUSE_GOOD/HOUSE_BAD or decoupled from its side mask; FACTIONS.XML's eleven
  entries (Faction1 GDI _00, Faction2 Nod _01, Faction3-10 the countries _03-_10, no _02) and per-team UIColor.
- [LAN games](engine/lan-games.md): only the host runs the simulation and the DLL; PlayerPtr switches per player,
  sounds are addressed per house, DLL keyboard reads see the host only, and every player needs the same mods.
- [Save versions](engine/save-versions.md): SAVEGAME_VERSION is the sum of class sizes and DLLLoad runs before the
  version check, so lead the DLL's save data with your own marker and version; a launcher patch can reuse the load
  screen's missing-map refusal.
- [Porting CFE Patch Redux into your DLL](engine/cfe-patch-ports.md): CFE ships its own RedAlert.dll, so port it
  instead; Vanilla Conquer already has some of its fixes; find changes by "Chthon CFE Note" and the INI keys; Vanilla
  Conquer removed EA's SaveLoadPadding, so ported fields change the save version; zoom is data only; attack-move
  needs named missions and reads Shift per player; the GlyphX sidebar's overlapping memcpy that neither VC nor CFE
  fixed.

## Units and buildings

- [Adding a unit](units/adding-a-unit.md): a new UnitType before UNIT_COUNT, a UnitTypeClass constructor
  (geometry offsets only settable there), registration in Init_Heap in exact enum order, a rules.ini section, and a
  classic shape so ImageData isn't null (null = invisible); its frame size sets the selection box.
- [Raising the limits](units/raising-the-limits.md): type heaps sized by enum; live objects and weapon/warhead
  types by rules.ini [Maximums] (ProjectileMax is never used); per-house MaxUnit throttles only the AI; the 75-entry
  sidebar column has a stock off-by-one.
- [Turrets](units/turrets.md): turret frame = body frame + 32 (hull 0-31, turret 32-63); the second draw is limited to
  shapes 0-127 in HD; Fire_Coord offsets; turretless units turn to aim only if tracked, else set is_lock_turret; a
  seat table is indexed clockwise by Dir_To_32 while body frames run anticlockwise.
- [Units leaving buildings: exits and rails](units/exits-and-rails.md): Exit_Object places a war factory's unit at
  Exit_Coord facing south and drives it out by radio tether; vehicles follow fixed DRIVE.CPP tracks (TrackNumber is
  saved); a new exit path is a per-unit straight-line rail, never a shared static table; sort under the doorway;
  two-cell curves skip a drive-on check; a new barracks needs its own exit point and list; Find_Exit_Cell's argument
  is unguarded; TD's refinery tracks are fixed to south-west.
- [Porting Tiberian Dawn units](units/porting-td-units.md): Speed = round(MPH x 100 / 256); Tracked= for SPEED_TRACK;
  fill RA-only geometry; ANIM_FRAG2 loads "FRAG3"; TD text IDs don't exist in RA; cloak/scanner is one system;
  Speed=100 is light speed and a visible shot never moves; impact animation from the warhead's Explosion= 1-6; TD's
  integer ratios against fixed; every infantry type and ship is a scanner.
- [Porting Tiberian Dawn buildings and defences](units/porting-td-buildings-and-defences.md): own type per port
  (hardcoded STRUCT_ checks, INI-name namespace, 32-bit prerequisite bitfield, From_Name below STRUCT_COUNT); TD's SAM
  rise/lower cycle, Obelisk charge and laser lines, muzzle offsets, MAKE build-ups, the WEAP2 overlay, Points= for AI
  targeting; TD doubles building strength; turret frames +32 recoil, +64 damaged, SAM +35; a sold building's crew
  at centre minus 12 px, a destroyed one's on its footprint cells; Animation_AI ends a turret building's
  animation only in construction and sale, so a turreted deployer's pack-up runs past its last frame;
  prerequisites are an AND list; a refinery that takes its harvester inside (RA keeps only stubs); size and
  footprint are separate arguments; flat buildings need FACING_NONE; TD SAM's state details and air-only threats; door
  frames follow Open_Door(rate, stages); Draw_It returns at once on a NULL image.

## AI and pathfinding

- [The skirmish AI and its IQ levels](ai/skirmish-ai-and-iq.md): skirmish runs as GAME_GLYPHX_MULTIPLAYER so campaign
  AI paths are skipped; [IQ] gates each behaviour and every skirmish AI gets MaxIQ; IQ below Production (5) stops
  base building; stock skirmish gives every house the Normal handicap whatever the lobby says; stock gaps: no ships,
  naval yards, silo, Iron Curtain or Chronosphere; only the spy plane, paratroopers and self-launching GPS get used;
  no parabombs in skirmish; radar only vs air; targets picked through the shroud; stubbed urgency checks; build picks
  are weighted dice; attacks are a timer and a 1-in-3 roll; the radar dome gates air defence, aircraft and both tech
  centres; every rated strategy acts, every 5-5.5 s; no gang-up (Paranoid), no threat map, teams never recruit,
  AI_Base_Defense compiled out, friendly fire spares only buildings; the enemy pick mixes cells and leptons and
  almost never picks; no build cheats.
- [Pathfinding](ai/pathfinding.md): stock RA has no A* (EA's edge-following Find_Path); zones ignore buildings
  (the 0x5F mask) but walls still divide them; allied vehicles head-on are MOVE_NO. Fixes: cfehunter's CFE A*
  (expansion cap, binary heap, per-cell visited table), give-way plus corridor claims, a no-progress give-up.
- [Harvesters](ai/harvesters.md): stock latches and overwritten orders strand harvesters; fixes: a no-progress
  detector, field blacklist, home rescan, watchdog, CFE refinery load-balancing; the ore search weighs an ore cell at
  GoldValue and checks the shroud only for the player's harvester in a campaign.

## New unit behaviours

- [Gates](behaviours/gates.md): RA has no gates; a gate is a building in a wall line, opened by an ally's request
  before each step (TS Try_Open_Gate), held open while occupied, closed after GateCloseDelay; rebuild zones after.
- [Subterranean units](behaviours/subterranean-units.md): port of TS's tunnel locomotion (OpenTS tunnel.cpp): a
  state machine, a live object moving in a straight line, hidden through the cloak check, legal surfacing cells;
  the dive tilts nose down and the surfacing nose up.
- [Firestorm Defense](behaviours/firestorm-defense.md): a charge-drain superweapon toggled by a patched cameo click;
  live sections kill, block and eat shots; airborne damage doubled because flying aircraft take half; line fill; TS's
  drain states, the 5x5 kill, free GuardRange line fill, EVA 00-I162/00-I170; the field drops on low power or with
  every generator off; its crackle is the anims' Report=; a section sells with no refund.
- [A stealth generator](behaviours/stealth-generator.md): set IsCloakable and let Cloaking_AI cloak; buildings never
  copy IsCloakable; scanner detection is one-way; hide bibs at draw time; Visual_Character per viewer; Do_Cloak clears
  friends' NavCom; cloaking a house's only factory of a kind cancels its build.
- [EMP and stun](behaviours/emp-and-stun.md): RA has no timed stun (its Stun() only clears targets); port of OpenTS's
  EMPulseClass: Damage = duration, Spread = radius, stun gates per action; TS's distance-tested aircraft pass, core
  defenders spared, sparks only on mobile deployers.
- [The Tiberium ecosystem](behaviours/tiberium-ecosystem.md): RA ore is LAND_TIBERIUM, so Tiberium needs its own
  overlay; the launcher's IsResource covers only GOLD1-GEMS4; blossom trees; infantry damage; Visceroids; grows only
  with the lobby's Tiberium option on, faster at higher settings.
- [Air delivery, fleets and support powers](behaviours/air-delivery-and-fleets.md): RA has no cargo plane; TD's
  airstrip calls Create_Special_Reinforcement; aircraft need a rules.ini section and non-null ImageData; a carrier's
  set-down needs MARK_UP and the exact coordinate; RA's aircraft box is 21x20 (Badger 56x56); port TD's fixed-wing
  landing run and its idle branch; TD's 0x80 drop window; the cargo clause commented out of Edge_Of_World_AI; a parked
  plane can be force-attacked.
- [Jumpjets, deployers, mines and bouncing discs](behaviours/jumpjets-deployers-and-more.md): MissionClass::AI skips
  non-aircraft with Height > 0; deploy where the build-up starts; drone mines as buildings; Distance() runs long.
- [Hover and amphibious units](behaviours/hover-and-amphibious-units.md): RA dropped TD's SPEED_HOVER; restore it
  with a speed type, a Hover= land-cost column, an MZONE_HOVER zone flooded by hover passability (one zone spans the
  shore) and MZONEF_HOVER in every Zone_Reset; TS's Hover= and Amphibious= tables; saves change; the zone-equality
  gates the spanning zone passes.

## Art

- [How the launcher draws sprites](art/how-the-launcher-draws-sprites.md): an HD frame's .meta is a canvas size plus a
  crop box, anchored by canvas centre; second draws use shapes 0-127; no rotation; alpha below ~128 discarded; ground
  shadows are baked (black, alpha 191); beam line frames 0-4 only, 3 lines per object; only TD's DLL exports beam
  lines; delayed animations draw before they start; height draws as a shift north; a draw scale scales each draw about
  its anchor (the turret shears); EA's measured vehicle centring (Mammoths 2.5 px high, bottoms 6-14 px below); the
  vortex's fixed 64 px export, top-left anchor and ChronalVortex fields.

- [HD tilesets and ZIPs](art/hd-tilesets-and-zips.md): a unit's art is a ZIP of <name>-NNNN.tga + .meta frames, one
  tile per shape in a patched copy of RA_UNITS/RA_STRUCTURES/RA_VFX.XML, a buildables entry named RA_<IniName>;
  TypeName = IniName, AssetName = graphic name; build-ups sized by BuildupData, overlays by their own shape; theatre
  art (smudges, ore) in RA_TERRAIN_<theatre>; ground art (smudges) gets no house colour.
- [Sprite memory and DDS](art/sprite-memory-and-dds.md): the launcher uploads every enabled mod's textures at
  start-up; ZIP frames cost 4 bytes a pixel of their crop; loose DDS frames about a quarter but need the whole
  canvas, and DXT shifts greys toward team-colour green.
- [Sidebar cameos](art/sidebar-cameos.md): stock cameos are 341x256 BUILDICON_* atlas regions; new ones are loose TGA
  or DDS; the DLL's sidebar AssetName picks the entry, so per-player suffixes swap cameos at runtime; Busy draws
  nothing.
- [Porting art from other C&C games](art/porting-art-from-other-games.md): Tiberian Sun voxels/SHPs, Red Alert 2
  voxels and C&C3 models into HD sprites: a 32-degree camera, 32 counter-clockwise facings from north, pure-green team
  colour, a baked shadow; TS theatre letters (GT/GA) and Image= file names; voices in SOUNDS.MIX by voice set, scores
  in SCORES.MIX; TS infantry frames port unreordered, barrel pitch 64 is level, railgun colours from LaserColor,
  DIG.SHP 37 frames and SAPC.HVA one; a building's frame 2 is never drawn; walker frames from WalkFrames and
  FiringFrames; <Image>BARL.VXL barrels even on SHP units, APC's water hull APCW.VXL; the Firestorm Generator's
  files are in TIBSUN.MIX.
- [Rebuilding art as 3D models](art/rebuilding-art-as-3d-models.md): TS buildings and units rebuilt as 3D models
  fitted to TS's sprites and voxels; TS's camera as maths (48x24 diamond, 0.2297 px per unit of height, the view-ray
  slide, the foundation's north corner at the frame centre); shape from pixels and the MK build-up; heightfield plus
  slabs; a ~0.9 silhouette shape check before materials; one light, house green (0,214,0) as albedo; TS voxel
  normals capped at 25 degrees; overlays cut against their base frame; glTF export by marching cubes with a
  house-colour vertex mask.
- [Building selection boxes](art/building-selection-boxes.md): the launcher centres a building's selection box on
  its plot and takes only the size from the DLL; a misplaced box means the art is seated off the plot's centre.

## Structuring a big mod

- [Asset packs](structuring/asset-packs.md): split art and sound into Workshop items the mod depends on; a pack's
  own XMLs never load (the mod carries the merged entries); the DLL detects a pack by a marker file found through
  CNC_Add_Mod_Path; share frames and ZIPs to stay small.
- [A player settings page](structuring/player-settings-page.md): every switch on by default and off meaning
  vanilla's own code path; an INI read once per match; in LAN the host's simulation switches apply to everyone.
- [New units without a DLL of your own](structuring/units-without-a-dll.md): stock RA has no INI route to new
  types; DontCryJustDie's Nuke Tank sample adds one as an add-on to his Veterancy and more DLL.

## Troubleshooting

- [Crash triage](troubleshooting/crash-triage.md): log/CrashLog.txt names the crashing process (ClientG = launcher,
  InstanceServerG = your DLL) and EIP; minidumps give the DLL's base and stack; addr2line on the unstripped DLL gives
  the line; ClientG RVA 0x56A539 is a deliberate assert write, so read the assert text; the game DLL imports no
  graphics library.
- [Known engine traps](troubleshooting/known-engine-traps.md): bugs in EA's released RA source every DLL mod inherits:
  the 512-byte mod search-path buffer overruns at about four mods; RULES/AFTRMATH/MPLAYER.INI resolve the current
  directory first; a sidebar column of 75 writes past its array; the 25-slot NameOverride table fills (no dedup, last
  slot unreachable); a crate that kills its driver; fixes under switches that are off (FIXIT_HELI_LANDING, TOFIX)
  never compile; a dead target's As_Coord is the map origin; production contracts (orders never ask Can_Build,
  Get_Quantity counts from production start, keep sidebar entries with production in flight, a cheap refinery gets no
  harvester, the draw export's shape name can be NULL); an animation's first stage runs none of its stage work;
  Cell_Building() misses the cells a building only overlaps; a warhead section without Verses resets it to 100%.

## Patching the launcher in memory (advanced)

- [Re-pointing launcher UI art in memory](clientg-ram/repointing-atlas-regions.md): give a third faction or
  sub-faction its own radar crest and HUD logos by rewriting ClientG's cached atlas-region records. Fragile: verified
  against one ClientG build only; why ptrace_scope doesn't block it under Proton.
- [Patching the launcher's code from your DLL](clientg-ram/patching-the-launchers-code.md): ClientG loads the mod's
  DLL at start-up for CNC_Version; DllMain there can pin the DLL and hook launcher functions on every machine.
  Compare stock bytes before every write. Fragile: one ClientG build only; ClientG has a fixed base (0x400000, no
  relocations).
- [Rewriting launcher strings in memory](clientg-ram/rewriting-launcher-strings.md): when ClientG builds a name
  in code (the sidebar tab-icon prefixes), rewrite the string in place, never longer, keeping the old tail behind
  the terminator so a patched slot is findable. Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [Launcher key commands and superweapon clicks](clientg-ram/launcher-key-commands-and-clicks.md): ClientG's command
  dispatcher (0x168A1B0) jumps through 0x168AD74; point deploy/select-all/camera slots at stubs that send mod commands
  0x1032-0x1035; the cameo click's superweapon test (0x73EA39) patched to send START_CONSTRUCTION; input mode
  0x20F1C90. Fragile: one ClientG build; a click can arrive as START_CONSTRUCTION_MULTI, so accept both.

## Open questions

- [Open questions](open-questions.md): unproven research only, never a recipe. Scripted co-op missions, players
  changing the rules, Tiberian Sun theatres, music built from the player's own copy, tileset video memory, which mod's
  loose file wins, theatre slots past 5, hiding units from radar, how a campaign ends, untouched launcher data
  (cursors, lobby lists, slash commands, CNCRULES.XML's difficulty table and CNC_Config). Each entry links TF's design
  doc.
